name: qsa-compat-reduced-deterministic
fixed: 2026-10-07, before any compat-only run, from model geometry and recorded pool sizes only; no model output was used
purpose: G2-2 compat-only arm (docs/baseline.md gap 7): fork with SGLANG_QSA_HISPARSE_V3 unset vs plugin with SGLANG_QSA_MODEL_COMPAT=1, cold requests only

base_profile.note: The deterministic comparison profile of docs/baseline.md, path relative to the workspace that holds results/ and service/. It is private (model path, served name) and is read at run time, never copied here. Its command is used unchanged except for set_flags.

environment.remove: every SGLANG_QSA_* variable and SGLANG_PLUGINS inherited from the caller or the base profile (V3 runtime, observation, host prefix cache, events)

derivation: Raw K/V per token per rank = 12 full-attention layers x 2 (K, V) x 1 KV head per rank x 256 head dim x 1 byte (FP8 E4M3) = 6,144 B (fork QSA_HISPARSE.md, frozen geometry).

Compressed index per token per rank = 768 B (pin QSATokenToKVPool.qsa_bytes_per_token: BF16 index-K bytes per C4 group / 4 tokens x 12 layers); docs/baseline.md records the same value as logical_bytes_per_token of the deterministic profile.
Without offload the pin prices one token at 6,144 + 768 = 6,912 B per rank (pool_configurator._compute_cell_size: raw K/V plus the QSA index cell).

Device KV budget of each 48 GB rank: the qualified deterministic profile (same model and flags, --mem-fraction-static 0.96) allocated fixed_bytes 1,611,399,936 + 2,097,152 x 768 = 3,222,012,672 B of KV pools per rank and still reported 3.30 GB available (docs/baseline.md). With V3 unset the offload runtime's device workspaces (hot caches, decode and graph workspaces) do not exist, so any compat pool of at most 3,222,012,672 B per rank fits with at least that headroom.
B8 at full context without offload: 2,097,152 x 6,912 = 14,495,514,624 B per rank > 3,222,012,672 B, which is why the base profile cannot run with V3 unset.

--max-total-tokens = context 262,144 + CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS 4,096 + page 64 = 266,304: one full-context request plus the largest decode reservation and the page-alignment reserve the pin's PrefillAdder.add_one_req charges, so every request that passes SGLang's context-length check is admissible on an idle server.

Pool per rank: (266,304 + 64 padding) x 6,912 = 1,841,135,616 B, 57% of 3,222,012,672 B (1,380,877,056 B spare). The per-request pending/RoPE rings (12,384 B per request slot) are negligible against that margin.

Everything else is the base profile: TP2, deterministic inference, context 262,144, page 64, FP8 KV, chunked prefill 2,048, 8 running requests, full decode CUDA graphs for B1-B8, radix cache and overlap scheduling disabled.

fixtures.rule: Keep every frozen case, in file order and with its tokens unmodified, whose len(input_ids) + max_new_tokens <= context_length (SGLang's request-length check); drop the rest. Fixed before any run; it depends on input lengths only, never on outputs.
fixtures.harness: fork test/manual/qsa_hisparse_prefix_acceptance.py baseline --max-prefix <max_prefix>: two salted cold requests per kept case; the harness file comes from the fork reference tree in both arms
